scenario_name: Edge Router Hardening and Malicious Proxy Blocking
base_template: Write a compliance report. Suspicious transfers to a malicious proxy at {{malicious_ip}} were detected originating from the LAN {{lan_ip}}. You must secure the perimeter between {{start_time}} and {{end_time}} by allowing only HTTPS and DNS.

malicious_ip.instruction: Generate a random malicious-looking public IP (e.g. 185.x.x.x, 91.x.x.x, 45.x.x.x)

lan_ip.instruction: Generate a private LAN IP in 10.x.x.x or 172.16.x.x range, last octet between 50-200

expected_solution: Configure a time-range, an Extended ACL blocking malicious_ip and permitting only ports 443 and 53, then apply it inbound on GigabitEthernet2/0.
